title: Resource-Adaptive Primal-Dual Learning for One-Warehouse Multi-Store Systems with Censored Demand
abstract: arXiv:2608.14096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The one-warehouse multi-store (OWMS) system is a fundamental inventory network in which a nonreplenishable warehouse allocates shared stock across multiple stores over time. Existing OWMS learning policies are built around a fixed target calibrated to the initial average resource rate, but such a fixed-target architecture cannot re-center after realized sales change the remaining resource available per future period. We develop Resource-Adaptive Primal-Dual Learning, a new learning framework that tracks the primal-dual resolving path with censored demand as the remaining-resource state evolves. In each period, the current resource rate indexes the target store allocations and dual variable, while censored sales provide gradient estimates for updating both. translated_title: 资源自适应原始-对偶学习用于需求截断的单仓库多商店系统
translated_abstract: 单仓库多商店（OWMS）系统是一个基本的库存网络，其中不可补货的仓库随时间将共享库存分配给多个商店。现有的OWMS学习策略围绕一个固定目标构建，该目标校准到初始平均资源率，但这种固定目标架构无法在实现销售改变每个未来时期可用剩余资源后重新居中。我们开发了资源自适应原始-对偶学习，这是一种新的学习框架，它跟踪原始-对偶解析路径，并在剩余资源状态演化时处理截断需求。在每个时期，当前资源率索引目标商店分配和对偶变量，而截断销售提供梯度估计以更新两者。分析结合了预期销售几何与移动目标论证，以产生对数期望遗憾，优于现有最先进的平方根阶保证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种资源自适应原始-对偶学习框架，通过动态调整目标分配和对偶变量，在截断需求下实现了对数期望遗憾，显著优于现有平方根阶方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a resource-adaptive primal-dual learning framework that dynamically adjusts target allocations and dual variables, achieving logarithmic expected regret under censored demand, significantly outperforming existing square-root-order methods.
